newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapor noon shares firm, focus on Jardine units.
newsitem.headline: Singapor noon shares firm, focus on Jardine units.

text.p: Singapore shares were mostly firm on Tuesday morning, led by strong gains in the Jardine Matheson group of companies.
Hongkong Land HKLD SI topped the actives list with more than 36 million shares traded and was up 51 cents to US$3.06 after touching a high of US$3.10.
The buying was triggered by news that Hong Kong tycoon Li Ka Shing had bought more than three percent of the shares in both Hongkong Land and Jardine Matheson.
"The buying is very strong and there is talk Li would be buying more in the open market. But it is very speculative and punters might take some profit later," a broker with a Singapore firm said.
The Straits Times Industrial Index was up 1.53 points at noon to 1,965.13. Total market volume was 132.37 million units with 152 gainers against 138 losers.
Property stocks were mixed. City Developments rose 20 cents to S$13.10, but Wing Tai shed eight cents to S$3.88 in active dealings.
"I think there is a bit of a technical rebound going on. But Malaysian blue chips are still very weak, though the second liners and speculative issues are a shade better," a broker said.
The UOB-OTC index measuring mostly Malaysian issues traded over the counter was up 3.06 points at noon to 1,064.21.
